summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 62 of the GSD workflow — a 'Unified Node Codec Core Keystone' replacing legacy `FolderMetadata`/`FileMetadata` types with a unified `Node` type system featuring dual-sealed bodies and generation-based AAD, across the full monorepo.
summary.outcome: Phase 62 fully planned (9 plans / 7 waves) and executed end-to-end: unified Node codec implemented, `folder/` and `file/` packages deleted, all consumers (sdk-core, sdk, web) compile-gated against the new types, golden vectors frozen, and all 6 must-have verification criteria confirmed green.

repo: The GSD plan:pre hook stack for this project includes: intel, research, pattern-mapper, schema-gate, tdd, and a non-blocking drift gate. Security and UI gates are inactive.

Nyquist validation is enabled and requires RESEARCH.md to contain a `## Validation Architecture` section; without it, VALIDATION.md cannot be generated and Dimension-8 requirements are missing from plans.
The `gsd commit` helper can return `commit_failed` as a false-negative while the commit actually lands — always verify with `git log` rather than retrying on a reported failure.
The `workflow.auto_advance` config flag exists and would chain straight into `/gsd-execute-phase` after planning; it is set to `true` in this project.
Pattern-mapper found 13/14 analogs for the codec; the authoritative codec analog is `packages/core/src/crypto/seal.ts` and the folder metadata codec at `packages/core/src/folder/metadata.ts`.

The schema-gate hook scans for ORM files (Prisma/Drizzle/TypeORM/Payload/Supabase); Phase 62 touches only `packages/core` crypto codec, so `registry/schema.ts` and `bin/types.ts` are not ORM schema files and the gate silently skips.
The project uses 1Password SSH signing for git commits; a timeout fallback to `--no-gpg-sign` is acceptable for unsupervised execution with commits flagged for re-signing.

Worktree isolation was available but sequential execution was chosen: pnpm monorepos lack `node_modules` in worktrees (slow per-worktree `pnpm i`), and the cross-package dist chain (core→sdk-core→sdk→web) is far simpler on one tree.
Drift precheck flagged 143 pre-existing elements due to a stale/missing codebase baseline map — non-blocking but noisy; `/gsd-map-codebase` is available to refresh it.

Core test count legitimately dropped from 228 to 190 after Wave 3: `folder-metadata.test.ts` (17 tests) and `file-ipns.test.ts` (21 tests) were deleted because both imported exclusively from retired types (`FolderMetadata`, `FileMetadata`, `FolderEntry`, `../file/derive-ipns`), not from the live `ipns/` module which remains.

code.finding: Still contains v2 blob logic — not addressed in Phase 62, zero impact under greenfield, deferred.

Has `"types": ["node"]` but local `node_modules/@types/node` is missing (declared dep `^22.19.7` in package.json); causes TS2688 locally but CI resolves it via fresh `pnpm install`. Phase 62 made zero commits to this file — pre-existing environmental issue.
`upload-batch.test.ts` has stale-mock type drift but passes at runtime (20/20) and is excluded from the production build typecheck — noted as informational, non-blocking.
`apps/web` has no `tsconfig.build.json`; using `-p tsconfig.build.json` causes TS5058 — the correct gate command is `tsc -b` (project references), not `-p tsconfig.build.json`.

New unified codec lives here: `types.ts`, `encode.ts`, `decode.ts`, `seal.ts`, and barrel `index.ts`. Composes Phase-61 `sealAesGcmAad`/`buildNodeAad` primitives. Format frozen via `tests/vectors/node-codec.json`.

Cross-language golden vector for vault v3 blob (two-key layout: `0x03 | u16_BE(readLen) | ECIES(rootReadKey) | u16_BE(writeLen) | ECIES(rootWriteKey)`). Must be a committed file, not inline in plans, to satisfy D-04 and Rust cross-language parity.

workflow: Plan-checker requires RESEARCH.md open questions to be marked `(RESOLVED)` before plans can pass verification — the resolutions must be explicit in the document, not just implied by the plan content.
Golden vector files must live in `tests/vectors/` as committed files, not inline in plan markdown, for cross-language parity (Rust consumer needs a stable path).
Partial-tsc verify commands must use exit-code-safe patterns; a trailing `echo` masks the real exit code and can make a failing typecheck appear to pass.
Plans covering more than ~43 files should be split into sub-plans (e.g., 08a/08b) to avoid context exhaustion in unsupervised subagent execution.
For a correction-without-replanning loop, iterating on RESEARCH.md alone is dramatically cheaper than re-spawning the planner — the `--research-only` flag exists for this.
The `gsd-tools query` false-negative pattern (reports failure but commit lands) requires always verifying with `git log` — do not retry on a reported `commit_failed`.
When spawning the plan-checker after a revision, always confirm all prior issues are marked resolved in the checker's output before proceeding to coverage gates.
API surface intel that returns 0 symbols provides no planner value and should be omitted from the planner prompt rather than injected as empty context.

Sequential execution on the main tree is the correct default for pnpm monorepos with cross-package dist chains — parallel worktrees introduce pnpm install overhead and dependency ordering complexity that outweighs the parallelism benefit.

friction: `gsd commit` helper reported `commit_failed` for VALIDATION.md commit but the commit actually landed (`2475ae35d`) — required manual `git log` verification to avoid a spurious retry.
Bash `node eval` for worktree mode decision had a quoting bug, requiring a clean re-run to extract the init fields correctly.
Wave 1 spot-check grep undercounted commits because feat/test commits used scope `(62)` instead of `(62-NN)`, making automated commit counting unreliable.
Drift precheck emitted a noisy warning about 143 pre-existing elements (stale baseline map) that is non-blocking but requires explanation context to avoid appearing like a real Phase-62 issue.
The executor for 62-08b did not explicitly print the `pnpm typecheck` gate result, requiring a separate orchestrator verification step to confirm D-02 gate status.

The pre-existing `tsconfig.scripts.json` TS2688 error surfaced during the final D-02 gate verification, requiring diagnosis to confirm it predates Phase 62 and is purely a local install-state artifact.

First plan-checker run returned 1 blocker + 4 warnings, requiring a full revision iteration (researcher markers, vector file location, exit-code safety, plan split) before passing — added a full subagent round-trip to the planning phase.
open_items: `apps/web/public/recovery.html` still contains v2 blob logic — deferred, out of Phase 62 scope, zero impact under greenfield but should be addressed in a future web phase.

`packages/sdk/upload-batch.test.ts` has stale-mock type drift — passes at runtime but the mock types are out of sync with the new Node types; should be updated when sdk behavioral stubs are implemented.

~30 consumer files across sdk-core, sdk, and web have `throw new Error('not implemented — phase NN')` stubs for write-chain, share, bin, and invite behavior — deferred to owning phases (primarily Phase 65).
55 sdk-core tests and multiple web/sdk tests are quarantined (`describe.skip`) pending behavioral implementation in downstream phases.
Local `node_modules/@types/node` is absent from the root install; running `pnpm install` locally would resolve the TS2688 in `tsconfig.scripts.json` without any code change.
Codebase drift map is stale (flagging 143 pre-existing elements); `/gsd-map-codebase` is available to refresh the baseline before Phase 63 planning.
Phase 63 is queued as the next phase per ROADMAP.
